offerings.name: Search
offerings.pricing: $7 / 1k requests；base price includes up to 10 results. Each result above 10: $1 / 1k results; AI page summaries: $1 / 1k pages.
offerings.free_quota: New accounts get $20 in free credits (around 2,800 searches) and the Free Tier adds $10 in credits every month.
offerings.output_type: Standard search results, URLs and page contents; highlights, structured outputs, and AI summary.
offerings.note: Enterprise supports up to 1,000 results per search; requests above 25 results.

offerings.name: Deep Search
offerings.pricing: deep-lite: $12 / 1k requests; deep: $12 / 1k requests; deep-reasoning: $15 / 1k requests.
offerings.price_basis: PAYG deep-lite / deep base price（up to 10 results）
offerings.free_quota: New accounts get $20 in free credits (around 2,800 searches) and the Free Tier adds $10 in credits every month.
offerings.output_type: Multi-step research with structured outputs and citations.
offerings.note: deep-reasoning is $15/1k; additional results and AI page summaries cost the same as standard search.

offerings.name: Answer
offerings.free_quota: New accounts get $20 in free credits (around 2,800 searches) and the Free Tier adds $10 in credits every month.
offerings.output_type: An LLM answer to a question, with citations.

offerings.name: Monitors

offerings.free_quota: New accounts get $20 in free credits (around 2,800 searches) and the Free Tier adds $10 in credits every month.

offerings.free_quota: New accounts get $20 in free credits (around 2,800 searches) and the Free Tier adds $10 in credits every month.
